title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Watermelon Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Watermelon Edition Pre Filled Pods deliver two juicy flavour combos to the Elf Bar Dual 10K. One pod fuses Watermelon with Strawberry for a bright, slightly tangy draw. The other keeps things clean and sweet with straight-up Watermelon. Each pod comes with a 5ml refill chamber, automatically maintained by the Dual 10K device. If you like juicy, vibrant fruit flavours, Watermelon Edition delivers freshness in every puff. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
